name: gcc-arabic-writer
description: Write, rewrite and review MSA, GCC and pan-Arab marketing copy with deterministic fidelity and style checks.

interface.longDescription: Write, rewrite and review Arabic marketing, advertising, brand and luxury copy for GCC and pan-Arab audiences. Use it for MSA copy, UAE or Saudi market adaptation, taglines, captions, websites, product descriptions, press releases, video scripts and business copy. ChatGPT writes the copy. Read-only tools normalize briefs, check numeric, URL and caller-protected literal preservation, and flag transparent style risks. Country dialect always requires native-market review.
defaultPrompt: Write three Arabic campaign lines for a fragrance launch in Riyadh, using Modern Standard Arabic.
Adapt this caption for a UAE audience, using Modern Standard Arabic unless I request Emirati dialect.
Polish this Arabic luxury copy and keep every name, price, date and factual claim unchanged.

positive.description: Prepare an MSA fragrance caption brief for Saudi Arabia without inventing claims.
positive.prompt: Source: Maison X launches in Riyadh on 2026-11-15 at SAR 450. Write three MSA Instagram captions. Keep Maison X, 2026-11-15 and SAR 450 exactly unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Normalize the supplied brief, let ChatGPT write three MSA options, then report literal-preservation and lint results without adding facts.

positive.description: Rewrite UAE luxury website copy while preserving supplied product facts.
positive.prompt: Source: Maison X presents a 42 mm watch priced at AED 18,500. Details: https://example.com/watch. Rewrite this for a UAE audience in MSA and preserve all four protected literals exactly.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an MSA-led rewrite and deterministic checks for the supplied size, price and URL.

positive.description: Create concise pan-Arab jewellery taglines in neutral MSA.
positive.prompt: Give me three Arabic taglines for a fine-jewellery collection for a pan-Arab audience. Use neutral MSA and avoid unsupported superlatives.
positive.expected_behavior: Return three concise neutral-MSA options and flag any transparent lint risk.

positive.description: Check factual fidelity in localized Arabic product copy.
positive.prompt: Compare source 'Maison X, 50 ml, AED 250, 15% until 2026-12-31' with candidate 'Maison X، 50 ml، بسعر AED 250، وخصم 15% حتى 2026-12-31'. Treat Maison X as a protected literal.
positive.expected_behavior: List missing literals and extra numeric claims while stating that the check does not establish truth.

positive.description: Review a GCC Arabic hospitality caption for style and dialect risk.
positive.prompt: Review this hotel caption for calques, unsupported claims, dialect mixing, partial diacritics and length: حيث تلتقي الفخامة بتجربة لا مثيل لها — شلونكم وشخباركم.
positive.expected_behavior: Return deterministic rule findings and avoid claiming native-speaker, legal or cultural certification.

negative.description: A literal translation request should not activate because translation is outside this writing plugin's scope.
negative.prompt: Translate this employment contract from English to Arabic word for word.

negative.description: Arabic tutoring should not activate because language lessons are outside scope.
negative.prompt: Teach me Arabic verb conjugation and quiz me.

negative.description: Trademark clearance should not activate because the plugin cannot provide legal availability checks.
negative.prompt: Legally clear this Arabic brand name and guarantee it is available in every GCC country.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with MSA-first GCC and pan-Arab writing guidance plus deterministic brief, literal-preservation and style checks.

ar-SA.subtitle: كتابة عربية لأسواق الخليج
ar-SA.description: اكتب وحسّن محتوى عربيًا طبيعيًا للإعلانات والعلامات الراقية ومنصات التواصل ووصف المنتجات والأعمال، للجمهور العربي عمومًا أو لسوق خليجي محدد، مع اعتماد العربية الفصحى الحديثة أساسًا والتوطين المحلي بحذر عند طلبه.
